description: Version bumps for the pins nobody would otherwise refresh: the dev requirements, the CI job container's python image and the workflow actions.
Renovate opens one pull request per group, weekly, and stops; review, CI and the merge desk take it from there like any other.
minimumReleaseAge is the cool-down: nothing younger than three days is proposed.
The floor core the suite also runs against (FLOOR_PYTEST_HA in the workflows) is deliberately not bumped: it tracks hacs.json's minimum, not the newest release.

packageRules.description: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins an exact homeassistant and is cut for every HA beta, so a bump can land on a beta core, which dev/check_core.py rejects. Its own pull request, so a red one holds nothing else up.
A new Python minor changes the interpreter the CI job containers run, which HA's own Requires-Python bounds: its own pull request, never part of a weekly group.
Held below 3.15 while Home Assistant's Requires-Python stops before it: CI refuses a 3.15 image by design, so the pull request could never merge. Remove this rule when HA admits 3.15.
Workflows outside .github run on the forge's runner, which is not GitHub: a newer action major can need a newer node than it has. Digest refreshes only there.
